title: Shipping Small: Building Software That Doesn't Fight You
description: A practical field guide to keeping side projects and small products simple enough to actually finish — scoping, saying no to features, and shipping something real instead of something perfect.
excerpt: The best codebase I ever worked in wasn't clever. It was boring, in the way a well-organized toolbox is boring — everything exactly where you'd guess it would be, nothing performing for an audience. This book is about building that kind of boring, on purpose.
